objective: Avoid canonical environment projection for eligible single-binding cache lookups without widening the packed cache key.
evidence: Full frozen-core diagnostic 45717337815 attributes 9.5960% of counted application instructions to prune_env_cold and 5.1178% to intern_frame, exclusive compiled symbols.
mechanism: Use a distinct 32-bit cache-key type with disjoint environment-ID and selected-value-ID domains. Value and environment stores already enforce IDs below 2^31. Only single near-binding support with no universe substitution is eligible; other cases retain canonical environment keys. Evaluation computes under the original environment; closures retain their existing canonical capture. Inference checking flags and universe scopes remain unchanged.
predecessor: An older pointer-representation single-binding trial was rejected at ratio 1.0275834977. This is a new representation-specific candidate: the compact IDs permit a domain tag without expanding the existing 64-bit pair key. The predecessor is not erased or counted as a success.
controls: Changing an unused binding preserves evaluation.
Changing the selected binding changes evaluation.
Equal bound-variable levels with different type carriers stay distinct.
Different universe substitutions stay distinct and use the original path.
cost_gate: Both distinct matched generic binaries must ACCEPT the exact 25,131-declaration prefix; two alternating pairs must show at least 1% fewer calibrated software-counted instructions (ratio <=0.99) before broad qualification.
if_gate_fails: Reject performance promotion and preserve source, raw counts and controls. Do not launch full Mathlib or a broad portable qualification solely for this candidate.
if_gate_passes: Run the unchanged 230 portable inputs and source controls, then exact complete Mathlib. Arena uses two workers and target-cpu=native, which are separate release-comparison obligations.
boundary: This is an independently authored prototype against an attributed upstream core. It is not a new independent kernel, full qualification, an Arena score or a release.
